primaryTextChecks.text: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”

contextChecks.before: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
contextChecks.after: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the LORD lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”
